question: Who became the first player to hit 350 sixes during IPL 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chris Gayle.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

__
 
• **Chris Gayle** became the first player to hit **350 sixes during IPL 2021.**
 
• Gayle achieved the iconic milestone in the IPL 2021 match between Punjab Kings and Rajasthan Royals at the Wankhede Stadium in Mumbai.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• A total of eight teams participated in IPL 2021.
 
• IPL 2021 was the 14th edition of the Indian Premier League (IPL). 
 
• **IPL 2021 was hosted in 2 countries:**
 
 
• 
 **9 April – 2 May 2021:** United Arab Emirates.
 
 
• 
 **19 September – 15 October 2021:** India.
 
 
 
 
• All the eight existing teams participated in this tournament while the tournament was totally unchanged from the previous editions. 
 
• In this tournament, the **opening match was played between defending champions Mumbai Indians and Royal Challengers Bangalore at MA Chidambaram Stadium, Chennai on** April 9, 2021.
